Meta.title: TRACACON
Meta.description: The community app of the TRACACON Trade Card Conventions. Collect. Connect. Trade.

Home.intro: The app of the TRACACON Trade Card Conventions in Stuttgart. Marketplace, chat, events and check-in for collectors are on their way.
Home.status: Under construction: marketplace and chat are live, events and check-in come next.
Home.notConfigured: Supabase is not connected yet. Sign-in works once the credentials are set.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.hint: You stay signed in on this device until you sign out.

Onboarding.title: Welcome to TRACACON
Onboarding.intro: Just a few details and you're in.
Onboarding.nicknameHint: 3 to 24 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen. Others will see this name.
Onboarding.confirmAge: I am at least 16 years old.
Onboarding.acceptTerms: I accept the <rules>community rules</rules> and have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
Onboarding.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. You'll use it to sign in on any device.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.bioHint: What do you collect? What are you looking for? Up to 500 characters.
Profile.dangerText: Deletes your account and profile immediately and permanently. This cannot be undone.
Profile.passwordIntro: Set or change your password. Use it to sign in on any device with your email address and password.
Profile.passwordSaved: Password saved. You can now use it to sign in on any device.

Admin.title: Admin: users and roles
Admin.intro: Team members will later handle reports and check-in. Admins can also assign roles.

Legal.imprintMissing: The operator details have not been added yet. They will appear here before launch.
Legal.privacyDraft: Draft: the full privacy policy will be written and legally reviewed before launch.
Legal.privacyBasics: To sign you in we store your email address. Your profile only contains what you enter yourself. Data is hosted by Supabase in the EU. You can delete your account at any time from your profile.
Legal.rulesDraft: Draft: the final rules will follow before launch.
Legal.rules1: Be respectful. Insults, hate and harassment lead to a ban.
Legal.rules2: No counterfeits, unmarked proxies or misleading listings.
Legal.rules3: You agree on payment and shipping directly with each other. TRACACON is not a party to the deal.
Legal.rules4: Report content that breaks these rules. The team reviews every report.

Market.title: Marketplace
Market.intro: Buy, sell and trade cards in the TRACACON community.
Market.results: {count, plural, =0 {No listings} one {# listing} other {# listings}}
Market.emptyAll: No listings yet. Be the first to post something!

Listing.photosHint: Up to 6 photos, ideally front and back. The first photo is the cover.
Listing.photoError: This photo could not be processed.
Listing.title: Title
Listing.titleHint: Card name, set and number, e.g. “Charizard ex 199/165 Pokémon 151”
Listing.descriptionHint: Condition, details, what you're looking for in a trade. Up to 2,000 characters.
Listing.contactLogin: Sign in to message the seller.
Listing.safety: You agree on payment and shipping directly with each other. TRACACON is not involved. The safest option is handing over in person at a TRACACON.
Listing.deleteConfirm: Really delete this listing? This cannot be undone.
Listing.removedText: This listing is no longer public. The team's reason:
Listing.removedContact: If you think this decision is wrong, reply via the contact address in the legal notice.
Listing.notVisible: Only you and the team can see this listing.
Listing.reportSent: Thanks! The team will review your report.
Listing.mineEmpty: You don't have any listings yet.
Listing.photosHintRequired: Required: one photo of the front and one of the back. More photos are optional (up to 6 in total).

Moderation.title: Moderation
Moderation.intro: Open reports, oldest first. When you remove a listing, the seller sees your reason.
Moderation.openCount: {count, plural, one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
Moderation.privacyNote: You can only see this conversation because it was reported. Please treat it confidentially.

Chat.title: Messages
Chat.safety: You agree on payment and shipping directly. The safest option is handing over at a TRACACON. Never share passwords or bank logins and be careful with prepayment to strangers.
Chat.inboxEmpty: No messages yet. Message a seller directly from a listing.
Chat.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
Chat.reportIntro: The team can read and review the reported conversation.
Chat.blockConfirm: Block @{nickname}? You won't be able to message each other anymore.
Chat.hideHint: It comes back as soon as a new message arrives.
Chat.youBlocked: You blocked @{nickname}. You can undo this via ⋯.
Chat.blockedYou: No more messages can be sent in this conversation.

Register.title: Sign up
Register.intro: Create your TRACACON account. The app is for ages 16 and up.
Register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. You'll use it to sign in.
Register.codeSent: Almost done! We sent a confirmation code to {email}. Enter it here to activate your account.
Register.noMail: No email? Check your spam folder too.
Register.resent: A new code is on its way.

Reset.title: Forgot password
Reset.intro: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a code to set a new password.
Reset.codeSent: If there is an account for {email}, we sent you a code. It is valid for one hour.
Reset.newIntro: Choose a new password. You'll be signed in afterwards.
